newsitem.title: JAPAN: TEC wins 40 bil yen refinery order from Petrobras.
newsitem.headline: TEC wins 40 bil yen refinery order from Petrobras.

text.p: Toyo Engineering Corp (TEC) said on Tuesday it and Brazil's Techint Engenharia S.A. had won a 40 billion yen contract to build secondary oil processing units for Petroleo Brasileiro S.A. (Petrobras).

The consortium is to build a 63,000 barrel-per-day fluid catalytic cracker (FCC) and related facilities including a sulphur recovery unit at the refinery, located near Salvador, by December 1998 for the state-owned Brazilian oil firm, a TEC spokesman said.
The deal to build Brazil's first FCC gives the engineering firm a competitive edge in its effort to secure secondary unit construction contracts for Petrobras's other refineries, he said.
